spec.title: TDS
spec.description: Displays the last known TDS value in ppm for the specific device selected within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time AS "time",
  NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds', '')::numeric AS value
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND id = '$id'
  AND metrics->'telemetry'->>'tds' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time ASC;

spec.title: Top 10 Temperature Logs
spec.description: Displays the top 10 highest water temperature measurements and their exact timestamps recorded by the selected node within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
WITH telemetry_data AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature', '')::numeric AS temperature
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
    AND id = '$id'
)

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY temperature DESC) AS "#",
  time AS "Measurement Time",
  temperature AS "Temperature"
FROM telemetry_data
WHERE temperature IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY temperature DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH latest_telemetry AS (
  SELECT 
    time as "time",
    (metrics->'sensor_status')::jsonb AS sensor_status
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
joined_data AS (
  SELECT
    t.time,
    t.sensor_status,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.time >= NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_online
  FROM devices d
  LEFT JOIN latest_telemetry t ON 1=1
  WHERE d.id = '$id'
)

SELECT
  NULL,
  jd.time AS "time",
  CASE 
    WHEN jd.is_online = 1 AND jd.sensor_status IS NOT NULL THEN jd.sensor_status
    WHEN jd.is_online = 0 AND jd.sensor_status IS NOT NULL THEN (
      SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key, null)
      FROM jsonb_each_text(jd.sensor_status)
    )
    ELSE '{"N/A": null}'::jsonb
  END AS sensor_status
FROM joined_data jd;

spec.title: Temperature
spec.description: Displays the last known water temperature value in Celsius for the specific device selected within the active timeframe.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time AS "time",
  NULLIF(metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature', '')::numeric AS value
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND id = '$id'
  AND metrics->'telemetry'->>'temperature' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN time < NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS "Status",
  time AS "Last seen"
FROM device_telemetry
WHERE id = '$id'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_telemetry AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    time,
    metrics
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN t.time >= NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS "Status",
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time >= NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval 
    THEN t.metrics->'networking'->>'SSID'
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS "SSID",
  CASE 
    WHEN t.time >= NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval 
    THEN t.metrics->'networking'->>'local_ip'
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS "Local IP"

FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN latest_telemetry t ON d.id = t.id
WHERE d.id = '$id';

WITH latest_telemetry AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    metrics->>'firmware_version' AS firmware_version
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  null,
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinates",
  TO_CHAR(d.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' ' || current_setting('TIMEZONE') AS "Date Registered",
  TO_CHAR(d.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' ' || current_setting('TIMEZONE') AS "Last Updated",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID", 
  t.firmware_version AS "Firmware Version"
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN latest_telemetry t ON d.id = t.id
WHERE d.id = '$id';

spec.title: Location
spec.description: Node location based on registered data, color represents node's status.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 
  d.id AS "ID",
  d.name AS "Name",
  d.location AS "Location",
  d.latitude AS "latitude",
  d.longitude AS "longitude",
  CONCAT(d.latitude, ', ', d.longitude) AS "Coordinates",
  d.node_id AS "Linked Node ID",
  d.created_at AS "Date Registered",
  d.updated_at AS "Last Updated",

  CASE 
    WHEN t.time IS NULL THEN 0 
    WHEN t.time < NOW() - ($node_offline_timeout || ' second')::interval THEN 0 
    ELSE 1 
  END AS "Status",

  t.time AS "Last Seen",
  t.firmware_version AS "Firmware Version"

FROM devices d

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    id,
    time,
    metrics->>'firmware_version' AS firmware_version
  FROM device_telemetry
  WHERE id = '$id'
  ORDER BY time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) t ON d.id = t.id

WHERE d.id = '$id';
